translation.title: Loxoprofen Sodium Hydrate Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Apply 1 plaster to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (an asthma attack caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics). Do not use it on the eyes or mucous membranes, on damaged skin or mucous membranes, on areas with eczema or rash, or on areas affected by athlete's foot or ringworm. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, breastfeeding, an infant, a child, or elderly. Follow the prescribed directions and dosage. Do not use an occlusive dressing. Shock symptoms (a drop in blood pressure, hives, laryngeal oedema, difficulty breathing), itching, redness, skin disorders such as contact dermatitis, gastrointestinal symptoms such as abdominal discomfort, or abnormal liver function test values may occur. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
